summary: NIP Group Inc. (NASDAQ: NIPG), a Swedish-incorporated, Abu Dhabi-headquartered digital entertainment and Bitcoin mining company, filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) announcing an extraordinary general meeting to be held at 8:00 p.m. Hong Kong time on October 16, 2026, at 29/F, Entertainment Building, 30 Queen's Road Central, Central, Hong Kong. The board fixed a September 17, 2026 record date, fully supports the proposed resolutions in the EGM notice and recommends shareholders and ADS holders vote in favor; ADS voting runs through depositary Citibank, N.A. This is a routine meeting notice, not a special situation, and no transaction, price, premium or advisor is disclosed. Watch for the underlying resolution content, which was not excerpted; absent a material transaction, no risk-arb angle applies.
